outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate the ability to comprehend, apply the multi-dimensional approach of public health sciences. Assessment:Written and verbal reports.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify proactive factors for disease prevention and risk factors for disease and disability. Assessment:Written and verbal reports.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate and apply behavior-changing techniques to maximize health and wellness. Assessment:Written, verbal reports, assessment tool and successful completion of service learning project.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate the concepts of research, program planning and evaluation strategies. Assessment:Written, verbal reports, assessment tool and successful completion of service learning project.
